title: Seismic Behavior of Steel Coupling Beams
abstract: This paper investigates the seismic performance of steel coupling beams under cyclic loading. Six full-scale specimens were tested.

title: Effects of Web Thickness on Rotation Capacity
abstract: We examined the rotation capacity of welded H-section beams across web thickness ratios.

title: Concrete Shear Wall Coupling Beam Database
abstract: A database of 142 reinforced concrete coupling beam tests collected from the literature.
